summary.plain: The international team that runs the PICO bubble chambers at SNOLAB, deep underground in Canada, searching for dark matter that interacts with the spin of nuclei. It was formed by the merger of the PICASSO and COUPP collaborations.
summary.technical: PICO operates fluorocarbon (CF3I, C3F8) superheated bubble chambers at SNOLAB: PICO-2L, PICO-60 (the former COUPP-60), PICO-40L (operating) and PICO-500 (under construction). Per the SNOLAB experiment page the collaboration has 68 people from 19 institutions in 7 countries (undated). Formation date not published; PICO is the successor name for COUPP and PICASSO's superheated-liquid programme.
